levels.chua_dat: Below the program's academic standard (Fresh graduates or candidates with less than 2 years of full-time experience) or the CV does not clearly state GPA/major.
levels.dat: Fresh graduates or candidates with less than 2 years of full-time experience
levels.noi_bat: GPA ~8.5/10 (3.5/4.0) or above, scholarship or top departmental ranking; major closely matches the applied track, or holds a double degree/supplementary professional certificate.

levels.chua_dat: CV shows no evidence of English proficiency (certificate, English-medium program, English-speaking work environment). Program standard: Meets the program's required English proficiency level.
levels.dat: Meets the program's required English proficiency level.
levels.noi_bat: IELTS 7.0+/TOEIC 900+ or has studied/worked entirely in English; confident presenting, debating cases, and interviewing on a panel in English.

levels.chua_dat: No leadership role shown: only a club member, or the CV shows no meaningful extracurricular activity.
levels.dat: At least one leader/lead-organizer role in a club, project, or event — with a concrete description of what was actually done.
levels.noi_bat: Club president / lead organizer of a large-scale event / project founder — with measurable results (team size led, budget scale, growth achieved).

levels.chua_dat: No internship/work experience relevant to: Strong academic background from top-tier universities in Vietnam or abroad
levels.dat: Strong academic background from top-tier universities in Vietnam or abroad
levels.noi_bat: Two or more relevant internships, or one internship with a measurable achievement (KPI hit, project actually shipped) at a company in the same industry as Garena.

levels.chua_dat: No evidence of analytical thinking: no quantitative coursework, data project, or case-practice experience.
levels.dat: Exceptional logical and structured thinking; comfortable working with data and breaking down complex problems
levels.noi_bat: Case competition achievements or a real analytical project + solid tools (advanced Excel, SQL/Python if the track needs it) — ready for both aptitude tests and assessment centres.

levels.chua_dat: CV does not mention any award, scholarship, or competition.
levels.dat: Has taken part in an academic/case competition or won a school-level scholarship/award.
levels.noi_bat: Reached the final rounds or won a major competition (case competitions in the relevant industry, national hackathon/datathon) or a national-level scholarship/award.

levels.chua_dat: CV shows no genuine interest signal or motivation tied to Garena or its industry; generic application reasons only.
levels.dat: Strong academic background from top-tier universities in Vietnam or abroad Clear and confident communicator, with the ability to work well in teams Proactive and gritty – you’re not afraid of hard work or starting from the ground up Deep passion for games – you understand game mechanics and enjoy discussing strategy with fellow players A builder’s mindset – you don’t just enjoy games, you want to shape how others experience them
levels.noi_bat: A clear, specific story connecting personal motivation, prior projects, and understanding of Garena's business/brand/values in Vietnam.
